question: Does the DENR CALABARZON announcement identify an accessible draft IWMP that could resolve Labac-Alemang watershed boundary metadata?

source.title: DENR CALABARZON draft Integrated Watershed Management Plan review/workshop announcement
source.provider: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) CALABARZON, Conservation and Development Division
source.indexedExcerpt: The DENR CALABARZON Conservation and Development Division facilitated a review/workshop of draft IWMPs for Lagnas, Macalelon, and Labac-Alemang River Watershed, and a WCVA for Camachile Ylang-Ylang River Watershed in Calamba City.

findings.confirmed: The indexed official announcement is a source-retrieval lead indicating that a draft Labac-Alemang IWMP existed and was the subject of a review/workshop.
findings.unavailable: The plan, its boundary annexes, version/date, methods, input data, positional accuracy, species surveys, and reuse terms were not retrieved.
findings.relationshipToFmbLayer: The announcement does not state whether the draft uses the Redelineated_Watersheds_Feb2025 layer or the polygons queried in the separate FMB review.
findings.notSpeciesEvidence: The announcement does not support any fish presence, species completeness, occurrence, diet, safety, access or fishing claim.

nextAction: Seek the official draft/final IWMP and its GIS annexes through a public or authorized DENR CALABARZON/PENRO route; verify version, feature definitions, source lineage, coordinate reference and reuse terms before using any geometry.
